text:
alex: Heads up, p99 jumped ~500ms on hosted around 11:22 UTC, alerts firing
jamal: saw it too, p95 also elevated. queue depth spike on pool-hosted-east-1
mira: I see a tenant with repeated long priming prompts — KV cache miss rate ~3x for that tenant during spike
alex: any noisy neighbor on CPU/GPU? rate limiter shows bursts and a lot of retry/backoffs
infra-bot: Autoscaler added 4 nodes to pool-hosted-east-1 at +90s, but internal priming increased cold-KV churn
park: pulled a quick profile during spike — kernel selector flipped to generic_matmul for seq>512, and copy_kv_cache() shows memcpy hotspots
jamal: that smells like coalescer hysteresis — bursts coalesced into bigger batches, pushing seqlen estimate high -> wrong kernel choice
mira: @park can you paste the flamegraph lines you saw?
park: ```
# flamegraph snippet (top stacks)
copy_kv_cache -> memcpy (38%)
matmul::generic_kernel (22%)
coalescer::wait_loop (10%)
kernel_selector::fallback_decision (8%)
```
jamal: confirmed. high memcpy + fallback to generic kernel explains latency tail. also saw high batch-size variance in same window
alex: temporary mitigation idea: lower coalescer.max_wait_ms for that pool and force smaller batches so kernel selector prefers fast small-kernels
mira: rolling config change to pool-hosted-east-1: coalescer.max_wait_ms=3ms (was 15ms) — patching now
deploy-bot: Config update deployed: pool-hosted-east-1 coalescer.max_wait_ms=3ms by mira (deploy id ab12c4)
jamal: preliminary metrics: p95 back to baseline within ~2m of change, p99 improving too
mira: follow-up: we should adjust KV affinity/prefetch for tenants that do heavy priming — prefetch aggression + lower eviction frequency for pinned prefixes
alex: also add a kernel-selector heuristic: if batch-size variance high -> prefer stable small-gemm kernel or earlier aux-kernel fallback
jamal: I'll sketch a selector rule and unit test for variance threshold
mira: filed INF-4123 with traces, flamegraphs, config diff, and mitigation steps
perf-bot: Perf ticket INF-4123 created and assigned to jamal,mira. Snapshot uploaded (s3://perf-snapshots/INF-4123/3305009999)
sre: I'll own the postmortem and add runbook steps: 1) how to quickly reduce coalescer wait, 2) when to force kernel fallback, 3) KV prefetch knob recommendations
alex: thanks all — great quick triage. add any leftover TODOs to INF-4123
jamal: TODOs added: selector PR, targeted prefetch change, regression test harness for batch-variance cases
mira: :thumbsup: closing thread once PR lands and metric window stays stable for 24h
